entities.summary: Alexander von Volborth/Aleksandr Fedorovich von Volborth, was a Russian palaeontologist. Volborthite, a mineral containing copper and vanadium and first found in 1838 at the Sofronovskii Copper Mine near Perm in the Urals, was named after him.
